title: SupremeAI Smart Context Selector — Layer 1-8 Priority-Ranked Context Assembly
description: Layer-1 contract for the smart context selector: one deterministic, priority-ranked context assembly handed to a coding agent before it starts work. One contract document pairs the SelectionPolicy (token budget, base priority, decay factor) with the resulting ContextAssembly (8 priority layers, per-item inclusion verdicts, budget clipping state). Layer semantics: L1 core constitution (AGENTS.md, AGENT_RULES.md — never clipped), L2 task issue & acceptance criteria, L3 file scope & adjacent tests, L4 memory sidecars, L5 ADR history, L6 knowledge items, L7 environment/runtime state, L8 hygiene/noise transcripts. Priority decays per layer as priority = round(base_priority * decay_factor^(layer-1), 3). Budget clipping is a strict deterministic cutoff in priority order (priority desc, then layer asc, then label lexicographic): the first item that does not fit ends inclusion — no backfill, no cherry-picking. Fail-closed: layer-to-name pairs are if/then pinned in both failure directions, item kinds are a closed enum with kind-specific ref pinning (repo paths for file scope, memory namespace+document_id for sidecar refs per memory-search.schema.json, ADR ids for decision history), repo paths reject traversal ('..' anywhere), clipping state is bidirectionally consistent (budget_clipped true iff clipped_layers non-empty), and recorded instants carry an explicit RFC 3339 pattern (format is annotation-only in Draft 2020-12). Cross-object numeric invariants (tokens_used <= token_budget, layer.tokens = sum of included item tokens, priority == decay formula) are declared here and enforced semantically by the spec's verification suite. See issue #29 and docs/CONTEXT_SELECTOR_SPEC.md.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this contract document.

SelectionPolicy.description: Deterministic knobs used to assemble the context. v1 pins exactly one strategy; new strategies require a contract version bump.

token_budget.description: Hard ceiling on tokens_used for the assembled context.

base_priority.description: Priority assigned to Layer 1; each deeper layer decays from here.

decay_factor.description: Per-layer decay multiplier d in (0,1]; priority(L) = round(base_priority * d^(L-1), 3). d=1 disables decay.

strategy.description: Clipping strategy tag. v1 is strict cutoff in priority order: the first non-fitting item ends inclusion (no backfill).

ContextAssembly.description: One assembled context payload: which layers contributed, which items were included, and where the budget clipped.

assembly_id.description: Unique assembly run id (asm- + 12 lowercase hex).

task_id.description: Task/issue the context was assembled for (e.g. '29' or 'task-33').

generated_at.description: Assembly instant, explicit RFC 3339 pattern (format is annotation-only in Draft 2020-12).

layers.description: Layers that had candidate items (at least one). Layers are pin-paired layer<->name; duplicates of the same layer number are structurally impossible via the if/then pins.

tokens_used.description: Sum of included item tokens across all layers; semantic invariant: <= selection.token_budget.

budget_clipped.description: True iff at least one candidate item was excluded by the budget cutoff.

clipped_layers.description: Layer numbers that lost at least one item to the cutoff. Bidirectionally consistent with budget_clipped (enforced by if/then below).

ContextLayer.description: One priority layer of the assembly. Layer number and name are if/then pinned (fail-closed in both mismatch directions because layer is always required).

layer.description: Priority layer index: 1 = highest priority (constitution), 8 = lowest (hygiene/noise).

name.description: Closed layer vocabulary, pinned 1:1 to the layer index.

priority.description: Effective layer priority; semantic invariant: round(selection.base_priority * selection.decay_factor^(layer-1), 3).

tokens.description: Tokens contributed by this layer = sum of INCLUDED item tokens (excluded items count zero). Semantic invariant: sum over layers == assembly.tokens_used.

items.description: Candidate items considered for this layer, in deterministic order (priority desc, layer asc, label lexicographic).

ContextItem.description: One candidate context item with its inclusion verdict. Kind is a closed enum; ref-carrying kinds are if/then pinned to the ref shape they must provide.

kind.description: Closed item vocabulary: constitution-doc/issue-contract (L1/L2), file-scope/adjacent-test (L3), memory-ref (L4), adr-ref (L5), knowledge-doc (L6), runtime-state (L7), transcript (L8).

label.description: Human-readable item title; also the final lexicographic tie-breaker.

tokens.description: Estimated token cost of the item.

included.description: Verdict: did this item make it into the assembled context?

ItemRef.description: Locator for an item. Exactly the shapes below are legal; the kind-specific if/then pins in ContextItem demand the right one. Path values reject traversal ('..' anywhere) and absolute paths (fail-closed).

path.description: Repo-relative file path; must not contain '..' (traversal) and must not be absolute.

MemoryRef.description: Pointer into the memory sidecar; namespace/document_id vocabulary mirrors memory-search.schema.json (issue #36).

document_id.description: Stable id of the stored memory document.
